description: This file defines a scraper class 'IrishCentral' for extracting recipe information from irishcentral.com web pages, including methods for author, description, image, ingredients, instructions, title, yields, and keywords.

classes.name: IrishCentral
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from IrishCentral website pages.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname 'irishcentral.com' for the scraper.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Extracts the author's name from the article header.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Retrieves the meta description content of the recipe page.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Returns the image associated with the recipe via schema.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description:
Parses and returns the list of ingredients from the recipe page, supporting

and

    structures.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Extracts the cooking instructions from the page, stopping at certain markers.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Retrieves the recipe title from meta tags.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Raises exception as total time info is not provided by the website.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Extracts the number of servings the recipe yields.

methods.name: keywords
methods.description: Retrieves and splits the keywords meta content into a list.
